content.short: Hong Kong licensed qualified custodian for institutional digital assets, run by BIT.
content.description: Cactus Custody keeps each client's assets in segregated on-chain addresses that can be verified at any time, under a Hong Kong trust or company service provider licence. Institutions get custom approval flows, whitelists and withdrawal limits, batch transfers, and in-custody trading between crypto and fiat. A DeFi connector lets them use EVM apps through MetaMask without moving funds out, and Chainalysis screening is built in.
content.meta: Cactus Custody offers segregated, verifiable institutional custody with approval workflows, in-custody trading and DeFi access.
